description.text: The major aims to cultivate high-quality dental professionals who master the basic knowledge, theories and skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine, have professional knowledge and skills of dentistry, and are capable of diagnosis and treatment of common dental diseases.The main coursesinclude Introduction of Dentistry, Dental Biology, Dental Anatomy and Physiology, Dental Histopathology, Imaging Diagnosis of Dental and Maxillofacial Medicine, Dental and Maxillofacial Surgery, Operative Dentistry and Endodontics, Periodontal Disease, Dental Mucosal Diseases, Pediatric Dentistry, Prosthodontics, Orthodontics, Preventive Dentistry, Dental Materials Science, Geriatric Dentistry, Dental Equipment, etc..The duration of study is six yearsincluding one year of internship. International students will be awarded theBachelor's degree in Medicine

duration.text: The BDS at Southern Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Scanned copy of valid passport’s information page;2. Scanned copy of Highest Academic Degree Certificate, Expected Graduation Certificate for fresh graduates(original one and English-translated one. After being pre-admitted, applicants are required to submit final Graduation Certificate to be eligible for official admission.);3. Scanned copiesof transcript of all courses during the highest academic degree education (original one and English-translated one);4. ID photo (2-inch blue background photo without hats);5. Scanned copyofForeigner’s Physical Examination Formcompleted in Chinese or English;6. English self-introduction video (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M);7. Certificate of Language proficiency;8.Financial Support Guarantee Statementand scanned copies of its supporting documentscompleted in Chinese or English, certifying that the applicant has sufficient funds to cover his or her tuition, accommodation, living expenses and international travels during his or her study in China. The minimum amount of funding required is RMB 150,000. Only one’s relatives can act as his or her financial sponsor. The statement should be accompanied by a scanned copy of the financial sponsor’s valid passport or identification certificate(self-supporting applicants should submit this statement);9. Original Authorization to the Guardian (for self-supporting applicants under the age of 18 by September 1, 2025) needs to be notarized with signatures. If not notarized in China, the endorsement of local Chinese Embassy is required.★ Guardians shall be Chinese or foreign adults who reside in China with stable source of income.★ Graduation certificateand transcriptshould be notarized.★The University will request for supplementary materials when necessary.★ Application materials mentioned above will not be returned to applicants whether they are admitted or not.★All the forms can be downloaded from the official website of School of International Education.

requirements.text: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizensholding a valid foreign passport.If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant should have foreign nationality at birth and hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, a record of more than 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country in the last 4 years (by April 30, 2025)is also needed. For people immigrating fromChinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above.Applicants should bephysically and mentally healthy, and meet the medical examination standards for applying for a study visa or residence permit in China.Age Limit and Education Background Requirements:(1)Undergraduate students: under the age of 30, with a diploma comparable to the High School Diploma in China..(2)Master’sstudents: under the age of 35, with a degree comparable to the Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese universities.(3)Doctoral students: under the age of 40, with a degree comparable to the Master’s Degree in Chinese universities.(4) General Scholar: under the age of 45, with a degree comparable to the Bachelor’s Degree in Chinese universities.(5) Senior Scholar: under the age of 50, with a degree comparable to the Master’s Degree in Chinese universities.4. Applicants should have excellent gradesand good conduct,without any record of violation of school rules and regulations, nor any record of public security punishmentor criminal record.5. Applicants shouldhave excellent grades and clear purpose of studyingin China, with aGPA of 3.0 or above in the previous academic yearwithoutfailing or repeated subjects.6. LanguageProficiency Requirements:(1) Master’s /Doctoral ProgramsChinese Medium Program:Applicantsmust reach a score above 180 in HSK 5or provide other comparable certificates proving Chinese proficiency.
